title: 卡塔尔航空CEO：未来五年接收138架飞机，如何平衡波音空客？
speaker: Badr Mohammed Al-Meer

segments.en: So that way allows us to, hey, you need to maintain your slots. You need to maintain your loyal customer base. As a result, we still have a pretty resilient picture just because it's demand-driven. And people still want to travel.
segments.zh: 这样一来，我们就能保持时刻资源，保持忠诚客户群。因此，我们仍然有相当有韧性的图景，因为这是需求驱动的。人们仍然想旅行。

segments.en: You talked at the beginning, just about new routes that you're opening up. And it makes me wonder about your fleet, and it's really what you're adding to it. I know that just a few weeks into the job you made a trip to France, you went to Airbus.
segments.zh: 你一开始谈到了你们正在开通的新航线。这让我想到你们的机队，以及你们真正在增加什么。我知道你上任几周后就去了法国，去了空客。

segments.en: How are you thinking about expansion of the fleet and that balance between Boeing and Airbus, which you and every CEO has to kind of consider at the same age? In the next five years, we're set to receive about 138 aircraft.
segments.zh: 你如何考虑机队扩张以及波音和空客之间的平衡，这是你和每位CEO都必须考虑的？未来五年，我们将接收约138架飞机。

segments.en: 138? Yeah, about 50% of them are going to be Airbus and the rest of it is Boeing. So our fleet's composition is going to be 787s, 777-9s, 8350-1000s, which we are the world's largest operator of those wide-body aircraft.
segments.zh: 138架？是的，其中约50%将是空客，其余是波音。所以我们的机队构成将是787、777-9、A350-1000，我们是这些宽体飞机的全球最大运营商。

segments.en: And we're going to recently add the new long-range 831s by the end of the year. They're going to go into service in the beginning of next year. So the combination of that gives us the ability to be agile, to pivot accordingly, and also optimize with our cargo business.
segments.zh: 我们将在年底前新增新的远程A321。它们将在明年初投入服务。所以这些组合让我们有能力保持敏捷，相应调整，并优化我们的货运业务。

segments.en: We are the single largest carrier of international cargo in the world, with about 12% global market share. So we're optimizing that from a freighter cargo perspective and a belly perspective. And cargo has been roaring from a demand perspective, especially this.
segments.zh: 我们是全球最大的国际货运承运人，约占全球市场份额的12%。所以我们从全货机和腹舱角度进行优化。从需求角度看，货运一直非常旺盛，尤其是今年。

segments.en: So they're roaring, I see, they're roaring. Floating, sorry. But you're planning for our cargo is important for you. Cargo is incredibly important. We're set to double down on our business. Agnostic of all we've seen with the straight explosion.
segments.zh: 所以它们在旺盛，我明白了，它们在旺盛。抱歉，是浮动。但你们对货运的规划对你们很重要。货运极其重要。我们准备加倍投入我们的业务。不管我们在海峡爆发中看到什么。

segments.en: We've seen demand pick up from the energy transition perspective, from the semiconductor boom, from all the funds that are going into all the capital that's flowing into AI. And as a result, our passengers are actually picking up that airways cargo to transport their goods to services in global.
segments.zh: 我们看到需求从能源转型、半导体繁荣、以及所有流入人工智能的资本中回升。因此，我们的旅客实际上正在使用航空货运将他们的货物运往全球服务。

segments.en: Have you seen an uptake in that part of the business, given that that is one of the few remaining ways to get things out if you can't ship them through the straight reliably? 100%.
segments.zh: 鉴于如果无法可靠地通过海峡运输，这是少数剩余的运输方式之一，你们是否看到这部分业务的增长？100%。
